test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 15th December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is India's highest (tallest) dam?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Tehri dam.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Tehri Dam is located in the state of **Uttarakhand.**
 
• It is the** highest Dam in India with a height of 260.5 meters.**
 
• It is also listed in the top ten highest dams in the world.
 
• This Dam is situated on the river Bhagirathi.
 
 
• **Height of the Dam- 260.5 m**
 
• **Length of the Dam- 575 m**
 
• **Type of Dam- Rock fill**
 
• **The reservoir capacity - 21,00,000 acre-feet**
 
• **The capacity that is installed- 1000 Megawatt**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sardar Sarovar Dam:**

 
 
• It is located in the state of Gujarat.
 
• It is the largest dam in the Narmada Valley Project.
 
• This dam benefits the other neighbouring states of Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, and Maharashtra.
 
 
 
• **Hirakud Dam:**
 
 
• It is located in the state of Orissa.
 
• It is the longest dam in India with a total length of 25.79 km.
 
• It is situated on the river Mahanadi.
 
 
 
• **Bhakra Nangal Dam:**
 
 
• It is located in the state of Himachal Pradesh and Punjab.
 
• It is situated on the river Sutlej.
